## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
This review found no defects in the reviewed scope, and the new flag follows the `cli-flags` and `logging` skill rules. The traced path runs from `--exclude` parsing through `collect` to the tar contents, and the added end-to-end test reads as asserting the result at that last step.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag to `cli/main.py`. The flag drops files from `collect` when their basename matches a pattern, and each skipped file is logged at info level. The pull request also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md`, adds tests in `tests/test_main.py`, and adds a text fixture at `tests/fixtures/hostile-review.txt`.
